name: I Decided to Open a Casino in Another Country, and Now I Have to Deal with the Crazy Gamblers There
source:
You, the owner of a small casino, are on the verge of ruin because you cannot compete with other large casinos.
But, as it turns out, there is not a single casino in the capital of the neighboring country!
And you decided that this is your chance for success!
So you sold all your property, moved to a new country and opened your own casino there!
But, as it turns out, not everything is so simple.
There are no casinos in this country, because no one has dared to open one there.
And all because of some crazy residents of this country, who can make inadequate demands on you… But, the casino is open, and you are a person with a strong grip, decided to take everything under your control and found a way to resolve conflict situations!
translation:
身为一家小型赌场老板的你，因无力与大型赌场抗衡而濒临破产边缘。
然而天无绝人之路——邻国的首都竟然连一家赌场都没有！
你当即断定，这正是你东山再起的绝佳良机！
于是你变卖全部家当，移居邻国，在当地开起了属于自己的赌场！
可事实证明，事情远没有想象中那么简单。
这个国家之所以没有赌场，是因为从来没人敢在这里开赌场——
罪魁祸首正是当地一群疯疯癫癫的居民，他们会向你提出各种不可理喻的荒唐要求……但既然赌场已经开门营业，手腕强硬的你决定将一切牢牢掌控在自己手中，找出一套摆平各类冲突局面的独门妙招！
